title: Chargers' Mike McDaniel 'always' coaching for his job: 'Insulting to do anything else'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chargers' Mike McDaniel 'always' coaching for his job: 'Insulting to do anything else'
sources.description: Chargers offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel says he approaches every game as if he were coaching for his job, but he knows the pressure is on amid an 0-5 start.
